<?php
/**
 * Payment Processing CLI Tool for Kubernetes Pod
 * Handles batch payment reconciliation from message queue
 * 
 * Usage: php payment_processor.php --batch-id=<id> --mode=<process|reconcile>
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class PaymentLedger {
    private array $entries = [];
    private float $runningBalance = 0.0;
    
    public function addEntry(string $txId, float $amount, string $currency): void {
        $this->entries[] = [
            'tx_id' => $txId,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'currency' => $currency,
            'timestamp' => microtime(true)
        ];
        $this->runningBalance += $amount;
    }
    
    public function getBalance(): float {
        return $this->runningBalance;
    }
    
    public function getEntryCount(): int {
        return count($this->entries);
    }
}

class CurrencyConverter {
    private array $rates;
    
    public function __construct() {
        // Rates fetched from ConfigMap mounted at /etc/config/rates.json
        $ratesFile = getenv('RATES_CONFIG_PATH') ?: '/etc/config/rates.json';
        if (file_exists($ratesFile)) {
            $this->rates = json_decode(file_get_contents($ratesFile), true);
        } else {
            $this->rates = ['USD' => 1.0, 'EUR' => 0.85, 'GBP' => 0.73, 'JPY' => 110.0];
        }
    }
    
    public function toBaseCurrency(float $amount, string $fromCurrency): float {
        $rate = $this->rates[$fromCurrency] ?? 1.0;
        return $amount / $rate;
    }
}

class PaymentValidator {
    private const MAX_SINGLE_PAYMENT = 50000.00;
    private const MAX_BATCH_TOTAL = 500000.00;
    private const ALLOWED_CURRENCIES = ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY'];
    
    public function validatePayment(array $payment): array {
        $errors = [];
        
        if (!isset($payment['amount']) || !is_numeric($payment['amount'])) {
            $errors[] = 'Invalid amount';
        }
        
        if (!isset($payment['currency']) || !in_array($payment['currency'], self::ALLOWED_CURRENCIES)) {
            $errors[] = 'Invalid currency';
        }
        
        if (isset($payment['amount']) && abs((float)$payment['amount']) > self::MAX_SINGLE_PAYMENT) {
            $errors[] = 'Amount exceeds single payment limit';
        }
        
        if (!isset($payment['recipient_id']) || !preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9]{8,20}$/', $payment['recipient_id'])) {
            $errors[] = 'Invalid recipient ID';
        }
        
        return $errors;
    }
    
    public function validateBatchTotal(float $total): bool {
        return abs($total) <= self::MAX_BATCH_TOTAL;
    }
}

class BatchPaymentProcessor {
    private PaymentLedger $ledger;
    private CurrencyConverter $converter;
    private PaymentValidator $validator;
    private string $podName;
    private array $processedTxIds = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->ledger = new PaymentLedger();
        $this->converter = new CurrencyConverter();
        $this->validator = new PaymentValidator();
        $this->podName = getenv('HOSTNAME') ?: 'unknown-pod';
    }
    
    public function processBatch(string $batchId): array {
        $batchFile = $this->getBatchFilePath($batchId);
        
        if (!file_exists($batchFile)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Batch file not found'];
        }
        
        $batchData = json_decode(file_get_contents($batchFile), true);
        if (!$batchData || !isset($batchData['payments'])) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid batch format'];
        }
        
        $results = ['processed' => 0, 'failed' => 0, 'errors' => []];
        
        foreach ($batchData['payments'] as $index => $payment) {
            $result = $this->processPayment($payment, $index);
            if ($result['success']) {
                $results['processed']++;
            } else {
                $results['failed']++;
                $results['errors'][] = $result['error'];
            }
        }
        
        // Final batch validation
        if (!$this->validator->validateBatchTotal($this->ledger->getBalance())) {
            $this->rollbackBatch($batchId);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Batch total exceeds limit'];
        }
        
        $this->commitBatch($batchId, $results);
        return ['success' => true, 'results' => $results];
    }
    
    private function processPayment(array $payment, int $index): array {
        // Validate payment structure
        $errors = $this->validator->validatePayment($payment);
        if (!empty($errors)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => "Payment $index: " . implode(', ', $errors)];
        }
        
        $txId = $this->generateTxId($payment);
        
        // Idempotency check
        if (in_array($txId, $this->processedTxIds)) {
            return ['success' => true, 'note' => 'duplicate'];
        }
        
        $amount = (float)$payment['amount'];
        $currency = $payment['currency'];
        
        // Convert to base currency for ledger
        $baseAmount = $this->converter->toBaseCurrency($amount, $currency);
        
        // Apply payment direction based on type
        $finalAmount = $this->applyPaymentDirection($payment, $baseAmount);
        
        $this->ledger->addEntry($txId, $finalAmount, 'USD');
        $this->processedTxIds[] = $txId;
        
        return ['success' => true, 'tx_id' => $txId];
    }
    
    private function applyPaymentDirection(array $payment, float $baseAmount): float {
        $type = $payment['type'] ?? 'debit';
        
        // Business rule: credits are negative (money going out from our account)
        // debits are positive (money coming in to our account)
        switch ($type) {
            case 'credit':
                return -1 * abs($baseAmount);
            case 'debit':
                return abs($baseAmount);
            case 'refund':
                // Refunds reverse the original direction
                // A refund of a debit means money goes back out
                return -1 * abs($baseAmount);
            case 'adjustment':
                // Adjustments preserve the sign from the original amount
                return $baseAmount;
            default:
                return abs($baseAmount);
        }
    }
    
    private function generateTxId(array $payment): string {
        $data = $payment['recipient_id'] . '|' . $payment['amount'] . '|' . ($payment['reference'] ?? '');
        return hash('sha256', $data);
    }
    
    private function getBatchFilePath(string $batchId): string {
        $baseDir = getenv('BATCH_STORAGE_PATH') ?: '/var/data/batches';
        $sanitizedId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $batchId);
        return $baseDir . '/' . $sanitizedId . '.json';
    }
    
    private function commitBatch(string $batchId, array $results): void {
        $commitData = [
            'batch_id' => $batchId,
            'pod' => $this->podName,
            'committed_at' => date('c'),
            'balance' => $this->ledger->getBalance(),
            'entry_count' => $this->ledger->getEntryCount(),
            'results' => $results
        ];
        
        $commitPath = (getenv('BATCH_STORAGE_PATH') ?: '/var/data/batches') . '/committed/';
        if (!is_dir($commitPath)) {
            mkdir($commitPath, 0750, true);
        }
        
        file_put_contents(
            $commitPath . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $batchId) . '.committed.json',
            json_encode($commitData, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT)
        );
        
        $this->log("Batch $batchId committed. Balance: {$commitData['balance']}");
    }
    
    private function rollbackBatch(string $batchId): void {
        $this->log("Batch $batchId rolled back due to limit violation");
    }
    
    private function log(string $message): void {
        $timestamp = date('c');
        $logLine = "[$timestamp] [{$this->podName}] $message" . PHP_EOL;
        file_put_contents('php://stderr', $logLine);
    }
}

// CLI Entry Point
function main(): void {
    $options = getopt('', ['batch-id:', 'mode:']);
    
    if (!isset($options['batch-id'])) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Usage: php payment_processor.php --batch-id=<id> --mode=<process|reconcile>\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    
    $batchId = $options['batch-id'];
    $mode = $options['mode'] ?? 'process';
    
    $processor = new BatchPaymentProcessor();
    
    switch ($mode) {
        case 'process':
            $result = $processor->processBatch($batchId);
            echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . PHP_EOL;
            exit($result['success'] ? 0 : 1);
        case 'reconcile':
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'reconciliation_not_implemented']) . PHP_EOL;
            exit(0);
        default:
            fwrite(STDERR, "Unknown mode: $mode\n");
            exit(1);
    }
}

main();
